**A.** The court will most likely not enforce the bar against this assignment. Under UCC § 2-210(2) and Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 322, a general ban on assigning "the contract" is read to prohibit only delegation of performance. It does not reach the right to receive payment unless the clause says so specifically. The team note says the opposite, but it doesn't match the UCC or the Restatement, so I'm not changing my answer.

CONFIDENCE: 85
